written_html:
Buy and sell used chemical plants and equipment with International Process Plants (IPP)

International Process Plants (IPP) buys and sells used chemical process plants and equipment. We sell complete plants, process lines and individual units to chemical, petrochemical, fertilizer, polymer, agrochemical and specialty chemical producers. We buy the same assets from plant owners that close, idle or restructure sites, then redeploy them to other producers. IPP has supplied process equipment worldwide since 1980.

International Process Plants (IPP) is the world’s largest seller of used process plants and equipment, with 15,000+ pieces of inventory and nearly five decades of experience. Buyers choose reactors, heat exchangers, centrifuges, dryers, filters, distillation columns and tanks from Pfaudler, De Dietrich, Alfa Laval, Krauss Maffei, Westfalia and other OEM manufacturers, in glass-lined, stainless steel, Hastelloy and titanium construction. Capacities range from 2 L (0.5 gal) reactors to 565,000 L (149,258 gal) tanks. Purchasing used from IPP can save up to 50% of capital and 90% of lead time versus buying new.

Plant owners sell shutdown chemical plants, idle process lines and surplus equipment to IPP. We act as a principal buyer, not a broker, and purchase complete sites with their land, buildings, equipment and intellectual property or individual units as-is, where-is. Our team values each asset and handles decommissioning, dismantling and removal at the seller’s site. Plant owners receive one payment under one contract instead of selling a site piecemeal. BASF, Novartis and a European CDMO have sold or marketed plants and equipment through IPP.

Buyers request specifications, inspections and quotations through IPP’s team. Plant owners start a sale through the sell-a-plant or sell-equipment form. Call +1 609-586-8004 to discuss a purchase or a sale with our team.

Reactors

Precision-controlled systems for chemical synthesis, available in glass-lined, stainless and specialty alloys.

We supply used reactors to chemical plants that need batch or continuous synthesis capacity for reaction, mixing and heat transfer under controlled pressure and temperature. As a supplier chemical producers trust worldwide, IPP sources reactors from Pfaudler, De Dietrich, UGE and Gale Process Solutions, documents each stock number and coordinates removal, shipping and start-up support through one team.

Our used reactor inventory covers:

  • Batch-type agitated reactors with complete agitation systems
  • Batch type body only reactor shells for buyers with existing drives
  • Hydrogenation reactors for high-pressure hydrogen service
  • Fixed bed catalytic and tubular continuous-flow reactors
  • Glass-lined reactors re-glassed through Universal Glasteel Equipment

Each reactor listing states capacity, internal pressure, temperature, material and condition, so process engineers can match a unit to the reaction before an inspection. Glass-lined units lead our reactor inventory, alongside stainless steel 316, 316L and 304, Hastelloy C-276 and C-22 and titanium, with capacities from 2 L to 80,000 L (0.5 to 21,134 gal). Pricing depends on manufacturer, capacity, material of construction and condition, and IPP quotes each stock number individually with a video or on-site inspection on request.

Featured listing: stainless steel 316L batch-type agitated reactor.

Used chemical process plants and equipment from IPP

International Process Plants (IPP) buys and sells used process plants and equipment from its headquarters at 410 Princeton Hightstown Road, Princeton Junction, New Jersey.

We operate offices in 15 countries: Brazil, Canada, China, the Czech Republic, France, Germany, India, Italy, Mexico, Pakistan, Portugal, Romania, Turkey, the United Kingdom and the United States. IPP has served 160,000+ customers worldwide.

Our chemical inventory covers complete plants, process lines and individual equipment such as reactors, heat exchangers, centrifuges, dryers, filters, distillation columns and tanks. IPP sources these assets from multinational chemical producers, toll manufacturers and decommissioned or restructured facilities.

The IPP group includes Gale Process Solutions (GPS), which fabricates new stainless steel process equipment, and Universal Glasteel Equipment (UGE), which supplies and re-glasses glass-lined equipment.

IPP affiliates acquired the GEO Specialty Chemicals site in Allentown, Pennsylvania, and agreed to acquire Novartis UK’s Grimsby API manufacturing site. In May 2024, IPP announced an agreement with BASF to market ammonia, methanol and melamine plants in Ludwigshafen, Germany.

Ross Gale, IPP’s vice president, wrote “Cost Engineering with Previously Owned Process Equipment” for Chemical Engineering in December 2024.

IPP company profile ↗
